newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Bulk shipper Frontline finalises moves.
newsitem.headline: Bulk shipper Frontline finalises moves.

text.p: Scandinavian bulk shipping company Frontline said on Tuesday it had finalised plans to transfer its Swedish operations to a new Bermuda-registered firm, Frontline Ltd.

"Through an offer to shareholders of Frontline AB, Frontline Ltd has become owner of more than 90 percent of shares and votes after full conversion in Frontline AB," Frontline Ltd said in a statement.

"The board therefore has the pleasure to announce it has decided to follow through with the offer according to Frontline AB's June 13 annual general meeting and to move its operations in Frontline AB to Frontline Ltd in Bermuda."
Frontline Ltd said in a statement that the board had decided to lengthen the offer period to July 11, 1997.
Frontline AB shares will be delisted from the Stockholm Stock Exchange from July 4.
Shares in Frontline Ltd will be listed in Oslo on July 7 instead of July 4 as was earlier announced.
The move of Frontline, which is controlled by Norway's John Fredriksen, is part of a programme to revitalise the company.
